observations: White game console with a horizontal black stripe, characteristic of the PlayStation 5 Slim model.
One DualSense wireless controller is visible, featuring the white and black color scheme.
A stack of five blue game cases is shown, with the top case clearly labeled 'FC 25'.
The console is positioned against a light-colored wooden background.
Watermarks for 'JIJI' and 'DEKINGS MUSICAL' are present on both photos.

claims.evidence: The console's physical design in photos 0 and 1 matches the PlayStation 5 Slim model.
Only one controller is shown in the photos.
Only one game case is clearly visible; the quantity of the other four is not confirmed.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a hardware fault.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.risk: The games may be digital copies rather than physical discs.
risks.proof: A photo of the disc labels or the physical discs themselves.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the system settings.
Photo of the physical game discs to confirm they are not digital files.
Video showing the console connected to the internet and logged into PSN.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
